Community-maintained; not affiliated with DeepSeek."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-acp-interactive"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Editor-facing Agent Client Protocol server over JSON-RPC stdio. It creates dsh agents on demand and "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"projects their live session events into ACP message, thought, tool, permission, plan, title, usage, "},{"id":"p4s3","text":"and command updates. Zed is the first compatibility target."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"The package ships both the UI transport plugin and the `dsh-acp-interactive` executable. The transpo"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"rt contains no domain logic; the executable loads the complete Cordis composition bundled in `config"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"/cordis.yml` — DeepSeek and user providers, the agent spine, model-generated session titles, file an"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"d filesystem-search tools, in-process subagents, shell, permissions, persistence, human commands, an"},{"id":"p5s5","text":"d the ACP transport — so ordinary users do not need a DeepSeek Harness source checkout. This UI brid"},{"id":"p5s6","text":"ge is separate from the upstream automation-only ACP transport."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"`dsh-acp-interactive` is an independent, community-maintained project. It is not affiliated with or "},{"id":"p6s2","text":"endorsed by DeepSeek or Zed Industries; it composes the published `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` packages behi"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"nd a reviewed editor profile and does not claim to be the official DeepSeek ACP agent."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Quick start"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"`--setup` stores `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` through the Harness credential store without echoing it. Then re"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"gister the installed command in Zed's `settings.json` (open via `Ctrl+Shift+P` / `Cmd+Shift+P` and t"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"ype `zed: open settings`); on Windows use the absolute path printed by `where.exe dsh-acp-interactiv"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"e` (using forward slashes `/` or double backslashes `\\`), on macOS / Linux use `which dsh-acp-inter"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"g forward slashes `/` or double backslashes `\\`), on macOS / Linux use `which dsh-acp-interactive`:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"After saving, open Zed's Agent panel (`Ctrl+?` / `Cmd+?`) and select `dsh-acp-interactive` from the "},{"id":"p11s2","text":"dropdown list at the top. JSONL sessions live under `acp-sessions` in the dsh home (see Configuratio"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"n), partitioned by each session's cwd and independent of the directory the server was started from; "},{"id":"p11s4","text":"set `DSH_ACP_SESSIONS_ROOT` to keep them elsewhere. Every server process owns a separate in-memory S"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"QLite session-query index, so several editor processes can share the JSONL source of truth without c"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"ontending for the derived index."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Skipping `--setup` is fine: a thread opened without a stored key shows a `Configure DeepSeek API key"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"` action that runs the same flow (see Authentication); clients without terminal authentication recei"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"ve its instructions as an agent-type method instead."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## What's new in 1.3.0"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Version `1.3.0` adds in-process subagents. The composed profile mounts the published `@deepseek-ai/d"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"sh-subagent` registry with its `spawn` and `fork` backends and two delegation tools, `subagent` and "},{"id":"p15s3","text":"`subagent_fork`: the model delegates a self-contained or conversation-seeded task and receives the c"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"hild's final answer as the tool result. In Zed a delegation is one tool card — the child's own tool "},{"id":"p15s5","text":"calls, replies, nested delegations, and settlement fold into a bounded transcript inside the card wh"},{"id":"p15s6","text":"ile it runs, and the parent's tool result settles it. Delegations wait in the foreground inside the "},{"id":"p15s7","text":"parent's turn, children inherit the parent's sandbox with approval pinned to `never` and never raise"},{"id":"p15s8","text":" an ACP permission request, and child sessions are not editor sessions. See the In-Process Subagents"},{"id":"p15s9","text":" Agent Note, and the changelog for earlier releases."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## What it implements"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- `initialize`, `session/new`, `session/prompt`, `session/cancel`, `session/list`, `session/load`, `"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"session/resume`, and `session/close`.
- Streaming text and reasoning, tool cards built from each too"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"l's own presentation intents (generic, diff, terminal), subagent delegation cards, plans, model-gene"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"rated session titles, usage, and permission requests.
- Session configuration options — the provider"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"/model route, reasoning effort, plan mode, and Harness permission presets — all switchable in a runn"},{"id":"p17s6","text":"ing session.
- Session-scoped MCP: stable ACP v1 stdio and Streamable HTTP servers in per-session Co"},{"id":"p17s7","text":"rdis roots, with deterministic `mcp__<server>__<tool>` names.
- A command catalog merging the sessio"},{"id":"p17s8","text":"n's `ctx.commands` view with the user-invocable skills discovered for its cwd; the bundled profile c"},{"id":"p17s9","text":"omposes `/permission`, `/plan`, `/compact`, `/goal`, and `/feedback`.
- Text, resource-link, and inl"},{"id":"p17s10","text":"ine image prompts, and structured user questions through ACP form elicitation."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"The full behavior — plugin contract, authentication, per-method semantics, configuration projection,"},{"id":"p18s2","text":" tool execution, and the token and KV-cache effect of each surface — is in the behavior reference."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"- `session/delete` is not advertised. The persistence Service Definition has no backend-independent "},{"id":"p20s2","text":"deletion method; direct JSONL or SQLite manipulation in this transport would bypass persistence owne"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"rship and reconciliation.
- `session/list` returns one complete page and omits `updatedAt`; a stable"},{"id":"p20s4","text":" metadata cursor and cheap last-activity observation belong in the session-query capability.
- Audio"},{"id":"p20s5","text":" and embedded-resource prompt blocks fail instead of degrading silently. Tool-result image cards rem"},{"id":"p20s6","text":"ain text-only even though prompt and message-history images are supported.
- Session cost is sent on"},{"id":"p20s7","text":"ly after a Harness backend supplies a reliable cumulative amount and currency; the bridge does not e"},{"id":"p20s8","text":"stimate cost from token prices.
- MCP supports stable-v1 stdio and Streamable HTTP configuration onl"},{"id":"p20s9","text":"y; legacy SSE and ACP-proxied transports are rejected. Additional directories remains outside this r"},{"id":"p20s10","text":"epository and belongs to the independent `dsh-additional-directories` DSH plugin project.
- Terminal"},{"id":"p20s11","text":" output is delivered at tool completion rather than incrementally.
- Subagents run in the foreground"},{"id":"p20s12","text":" only. `run_in_background`, continuable children, `send_message`, `interrupt_agent`, `list_agents`, "},{"id":"p20s13","text":"and the out-of-process ACP, Codex, and Claude Code backends are not composed. A restored session rep"},{"id":"p20s14","text":"lays a delegation as its settled result card without the child transcript, and stable ACP has no chi"},{"id":"p20s15","text":"ld-session capability yet, so the card carries the child session id in `_meta.dsh_subagent` rather t"},{"id":"p20s16","text":"han a navigable child thread."}],"truncated":true}
